text:
mira: heads up — quota widget showing the previous org's numbers after a rapid org switch in console. saw it on prod around 09:12 UTC, small % of users.

alex: can you repro and share steps?

mira: repro steps (easy):
1) login as org-A
2) open Console -> Insights -> Quota widget (it fetches /internal/metrics)
3) switch org quickly via topbar to org-B
4) widget shows org-A values for ~3-7s then corrects

network log snippet: 
GET /internal/metrics?panel=quota 200 OK
Headers:
  x-org-id: org-A
  accept: application/json
  cookie: session=...

sam: i can repro on staging with feature-flag rapid-switch-v2 enabled. looks timing-related.

mira: digging: the panel adapter holds a module-scoped "currentOrg" that gets set in one place but reads in another async path. here's the offending pattern simplified:

```
// module adapter.js (pseudo)
let currentOrg = null
export function setOrg(o) { currentOrg = o }
export async function fetchMetrics() {
  const org = currentOrg
  return fetch(`/internal/metrics?org=${org}`)
}
```

component does setOrg(newOrg) immediately on switch but fetchMetrics can be queued by the render tree and run after a microtask delay, reading stale currentOrg.

alex: yep module-scope mutable state + async fetch = classic race. can we just thread org through the callstack instead of relying on module state?

julian: short plan: patch adapter to accept org param (non-breaking wrapper), add a guard in the fetch path: if response.org !== requestedOrg then discard and emit a telemetry event. i'll open PR.

mira: reprod payload from prod: response payload had a meta.org: "org-A" while the UI context was "org-B". users seeing wrong quota briefly.

sam: any customer impact? billing/visibility?

mira: surface-level only — the underlying usage is correct. only display mismatch, but it's confusing and could affect ops decisions if they glance right after switching. severity: P2, but high noise.

alex: rollout plan: patch adapter -> add small e2e for rapid switch -> flag rollout behind rapid-switch-v2 = off by default -> enable for 10% -> monitor telemetry. also add a kill-switch flag in case.

julian: PR: #8321 patch ready, unit tests included. i'll cherry-pick to a hotfix branch for prod patch if we want faster mitigation.

mira: can we also emit an instrumentation counter `console.widget.scope_mismatch` with tags {widget:quota, from_org, to_org} so we can quantify incidence?

alex: yes please. add to the PR. ops: add an alert if rate > 5/min for prod.

deploy-bot: deploy status: staging deploy 1749987700 succeeded (service/console-api v2.14.3).

sam: verified staging patch — no repro after change under heavy rapid-switch selenium test.

julian: i'll land to canary next and open a rollout ticket. cc @mira for verify on prod after canary.

mira: thanks. assigning to julian for rollout + alex for postmortem note. leaving thread here but will ping if any regression shows up. :thumbsup:
